customer_narrative: Man from the bank fraud team rang me, said my account was compromised and a mule account was taking money out. He stayed on the line while I moved my savings to the secure holding account he gave me. He told me not to mention it to the branch because staff might be involved.

Buying a second hand sofa I saw on a marketplace listing. Seller wants the money before I collect on Saturday because he says he has other people interested. I have his address and we have spoken on the phone twice.

My advisor at the firm has shown me the platform where my balance is up 31 percent since November. This is the second tranche. He says the window on this allocation closes Friday and the desk cannot hold the price after that.
Paying my gas bill, the direct debit bounced last month because I changed accounts.

My partner is a marine engineer working on a rig off Lagos. We have been talking for eight months. His pay is held up by the contractor and he needs the flight and the customs release fee to come home. I have not met him in person yet but we speak every day.

Moving money into my exchange account to buy bitcoin. The trader in the group chat shows his screen every day and everyone there is making money. He said to start with six thousand to get into the higher tier.

Had a voicemail saying there is a warrant out for unpaid tax and officers will attend today unless the penalty is settled. I called the number back and they told me to pay by transfer and stay on the line. I am scared.

Deposit for the loft conversion. Builder emailed to say his bank details have changed since the quote and to use the new account on the revised invoice. Same email thread we have been using for six weeks.
Sending my flatmate my half of the rent like every month.

This is for a shipment of solar inverters for my business. I found the supplier on a trade directory. They want full payment up front by transfer before they will release the container and they will not do an escrow.

Four tickets from someone in a fan group on social media. She says the resale site takes too long and to send by bank transfer as friends and family so it goes through faster. She has good feedback in the group comments.
Completion money for the house. I rang the solicitor's switchboard on the number from their website and confirmed the account details with the person who has handled the file throughout.

A recruiter offered me remote work reviewing products. I get paid commission but I have to fund my own task account first to unlock the higher value tasks. I have taken out three hundred already so it works. They said do not discuss it with the bank because banks block this kind of earning.
Deposit for a puppy. They sent lovely photos and a video. They will not let me visit because of biosecurity but they will deliver by a specialist courier for a further fee on the day.
